performance.verdict: CPL collapse is structural, not a blip — creative pool exhausted on sole active channel.

findings.text: CPL spiked 83.46% week-over-week on flat spend (+1.22%), while leads fell 44.83% — 28-day CPL of $7.46 masks a deteriorating recent rate.
OVERDUE: 5 milestones past due (earliest 2026-07-23): attribution gap, CRM cleanup, dashboard, and August renewal scoreboard — all unresolved as of today.
3-day lead signal (Sep 8–10): 4+1+1=6 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7): 6+2+4=12 — a 50% drop confirming the 7d trend is accelerating, not stabilising.
Top campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting' consumed $375.24 of $738.76 (51%) over 28 days — flat spend into a warm pool shrinking explains the fatigue pattern.
GHL shows 102 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — leads are entering the pipeline but not converting to booked chairs; intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Inject at least 2 new creatives into 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting' to counter confirmed warm-pool exhaustion; do not raise budget yet.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS retargeting campaign has consumed $375.24 at 51% of 28-day spend while leads halved in the last 3 days (6 vs 12 prior 3 days) and CPL rose 83.46% — a confirmed warm-pool fatigue signal. Action: produce and launch 2 new ad creatives into this campaign without increasing the daily budget. Success check: CPL returns below $10 (recent baseline implied by 28-day $7.46 average) within 7 days of creative launch. Re-evaluate by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Escalate the 0-appointment, 0-won pipeline in GHL — 102 opportunities stalled; confirm intake process is routing leads to Lily or the new hire.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 102 opportunities created in the 28-day window with 0 won and 0 appointments booked — leads are arriving but not reaching the chair, which is the client's stated scoreboard metric. This is an intake routing issue, not an ads problem. Action: Sohib to confirm with Lily and the new intake hire that all GHL leads are being contacted within 1 business day and appointment offers are being logged. Success check: at least 5 appointments appear in GHL within 7 days. Re-check 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions (down 50%, 0 for last 4 days Sep 7–10) — if zero persists through Sep 14, escalate as a tracking or profile issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 50% week-over-week and have shown 0 for the last 4 recorded days (Sep 7–10), coinciding with 5 overdue SOW milestones including the attribution gap. No action is taken this cycle as this may reflect a data-pull gap rather than a true organic drop. Monitor: if GBP actions remain at 0 through 2026-09-14, escalate to Attribution team to confirm the phone-match and GBP tracking pipeline is live. Re-check 2026-09-14.
